name: progress-pet
description: Mochi returns explicit Allow/Deny decisions through trusted synchronous Codex permission hooks, with a separate explanation chat.

interface.shortDescription: Your project buddy, a double right-click away
interface.longDescription: Reply to supported Codex permission hooks directly with Allow once or Deny in Mochi. Ask about a request before deciding. Exact hook review is required once; unsupported native cards remain in Codex. Includes chat-derived checklists and 1.5-second top-right announcements.
defaultPrompt: Open Mochi and automatically follow my working Codex chats.
Track this project and show me its progress and approval alerts.
